title: Multiple high-clearance sources say UAP is a real phenomenon

tellings.quote: One thing I've learned over the last year, I've heard from a whole bunch of people, totally separate sources with like very, very high security clearances, and I mean very high.

plain: Over roughly a year, the economist Tyler Cowen says, a number of people holding very high security clearances told him that UAP, the government's term for UFOs, are a real phenomenon. Cowen stresses that these sources were completely separate from one another and that their clearances were "very, very high." If true, it would mean people inside secret government circles take the subject seriously.
